requirements.text: Personalised timetable management should allow students to select different colours for various types of classes (lectures, tutorials) and hide cancelled classes to reduce clutter.
Automated grade notifications should be sent primarily via email, with the option for push notifications through the portal, providing immediate updates when grades are released.

A structured module feedback system should include a simple form that allows students to provide feedback on course content and delivery, focusing on the helpfulness of materials and clarity of lectures.
The enhancements must integrate seamlessly with the existing portal infrastructure to avoid significant disruption or hassle.
Students should be able to use the personalised timetable weekly for tracking classes, receive timely grade notifications via email, and fill out feedback forms quickly and easily after modules.
